$description: Fume screens: the moments that make Fume Fume, composed from the round 7 components. The Quality Gate review (Anna's screen), the creative viewer, notifications, the share dialog and the first run. DECIDED 13 Oct 2026 (approved on the review board, F-D072 to F-D075), first shown in round 8, 13 Oct 2026. Component files: qg-review.css + qg-review.js, viewer.css + viewer.js, notify.css + notify.js, share.css + share.js, onboard.css. Every value points at a brand primitive or an existing UI role; no new colours. Build: node tools/tokens/build.mjs

panel-width.description: Anna's side panel on a wide screen: the Brand DNA checklist, her notes and the decision. Under 720 px of screen it becomes a glass sheet at the bottom.

well.description: The well the creative sits in: one step below the page, so the white creative and its hairline come forward. The work is the brightest thing on the screen.

media-feed.description: Widest a Feed creative (4:5) shows in the well; a Story (9:16) shows narrower and a Banner (1.91:1) wider, so all three read at about the same weight.

media-story.description: Widest a Story creative (9:16) shows in the well.

media-banner.description: Widest a Banner creative (1.91:1) shows in the well.

pin.description: Anna's numbered pin on the creative: a 28 px drop whose point (the square corner) sits on the spot. Its hit area is 44.

pin-bg.description: A pin at rest: Porcelain at 94 %, the white of the main glass button, with an Ink number and the small glass shadow, so it reads on any photo without a ring.

pin-active.description: The pin whose note is open, hovered or focused: Ink with a Paper number. Ink decides; never Amber, which is only the check.

marker.description: The checklist's marks: the Ink check on an item that passed, and the small pin (the same drop as on the creative) on an item with a note.

note-bg.description: A checklist item with a note, and Anna's comment: one surface step off the page. Changes are told in words, never in red.

key-on-ink.description: The shortcut key inside the Ink Approve button (A): a Porcelain veil, like a clear glass button, so the key reads without a stroke.

key-on-ink-fg.description: The letter on that key: Porcelain at 86 %, 13:1 on Ink.

seal-height.description: The status seal on the creative (In check, Checked, Changes requested): a white 32 px pill lifted by depth, in the creative's bottom-left corner.

land-scale.description: The check moment: the checked triangle lands from 1.8 times its size and from blur to sharp (soft to sharp), over --ui-motion-slow. Calm, once, no bounce.

land-blur.description: How soft the checked triangle starts before it lands sharp.

peek.description: On a phone the sheet first shows only the summary and the decision: this much of the screen's foot is kept clear for it, so the creative above stays whole.

phone-height.description: Height of the review screen in its phone layout on the board (the app uses the whole screen).

ground.description: The viewer's ground: Ink. Allowed here only, because a creative is judged best on dark, with nothing else in view.

fg.description: Text and icons on the Ink ground, 17.9:1.

fg-secondary.description: Secondary text on Ink and on the info panel: Porcelain at 72 %, 9:1 or better.

surface.description: The info panel on the Ink ground: one step lighter, no stroke. Glass would vanish on Ink, so the panel steps up instead of blurring.

tool-on.description: A tool on the Ink ground that is on (the info panel shown): the clear veil (Porcelain at 10 %, the glass-clear button) doubled. The tools themselves are .ui-btn--glass-clear: on Ink the veil reads as it does on Smoke.

panel-width.description: The info panel beside the creative on a wide screen; on a phone it rises from the bottom.

pad.description: Least air between the creative and the edge of the viewer's stage (32), so the creative never touches the tools.

zoom-max.description: Zoom steps: fit, 1.5, 2 and 3 times. Past fit the creative pans with a drag.

swipe.description: 48px. A swipe this far sideways moves to the next or previous creative; shorter, the creative springs back.

width.description: The bell's popover: a glass float wide enough for two lines of a notification beside its avatar.

row.description: One notification in the popover: every row the same height (two lines of text), so the list can stop on half a row.

label.description: A group label (Today, Yesterday) in the popover list.

rows-visible.description: The popover list stops after three and a half rows: the half row says there is more below (never a sliver).

dot.description: Unread: a 6 px dot in front of the row, Ink on the page and Porcelain on glass, with the words at full strength. Never blue, never Amber.

dot-on-page.description: The unread dot on the page: Ink.

dot-on-glass.description: The unread dot on glass: Porcelain.

count.description: The unread count on the bell: an 18 px Ink pill with Paper numbers, cut out of the bar with the ground colour.

inbox-width.description: The inbox page's column: a calm reading width, centred on a wide screen.

thumb.description: A creative thumbnail in an inbox row (32 wide, 4:5), with the creative's hairline.

width.description: The share dialog: wide enough for the email, the role and Invite on one line, and a person's name and role side by side. On a phone it is a sheet at the bottom.

role-width.description: The role select beside the email field (Viewer, Can comment, Can approve).

copied.description: How long Copy link says Copied before it turns back.

list-max.description: People with access scroll inside this height: four rows and half of the fifth.

measure.description: Line length of the welcome text.

step-min.description: Narrowest step card: three side by side on a wide screen, one under the other on a phone.

mark.description: The step's mark: its number on the sunken step, and an Ink circle with a Paper check once it is done. Never Amber: Amber is only a creative Anna checked.

ground.description: The first run lies on Paper: a brand moment, the welcome, edge to edge like a Paper section (decided with Warmer, Marcus 13 Oct; round 9; round 8 had Porcelain).

card.description: On Paper the step cards and the empty campaigns are Porcelain, so a card never matches its ground.
